title: Structure Pack Solo #24 (맥시 비대칭 몬드리안·물결 | 공작눈무늬+코이비늘+드래곤비늘+이레즈미)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, two thick goddess braids — her body carries 4 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 irregular rectangular areas by hazy transition zones running both vertically and horizontally. One vertical transition zone runs the full height of her figure about 51% of the way across her figure from her left edge. To her left of it, a horizontal transition zone crosses about 72% of the way down her figure from the top; to her right of it, a different horizontal transition zone crosses about 29% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is the upper area to her left of the vertical zone, above the left horizontal zone: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD eye-marking centres, VIVID DEEP BLUE radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Region 2 is the lower area to her left of the vertical zone, below the left horizontal zone: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID PLATINUM scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the upper area to her right of the vertical zone, above the right horizontal zone: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING METALLIC SILVER scale formations, VIVID PALE BLUE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is the lower area to her right of the vertical zone, below the right horizontal zone: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, great wave formations in DEEP COBALT and STARK WHITE, extreme high-gloss oil finish. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme curvy petite silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
